quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor HKEX announcement: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 business review (interim results): the company says AI infrastructure drove a structural upcycle whose demand spread from memory and advanced logic to server-related and mature-node products (power management ICs, microcontrollers, power discretes), lifting foundry utilisation and wafer prices. Demand across its power management, embedded NVM, standalone NVM and low- and medium-voltage power discrete platforms exceeded available capacity; power management platform sales rose nearly 40%, embedded NVM over 40% and standalone NVM nearly 80% year on year. Technology: 40nm eFlash entered risk production, automotive-grade 55nm eFlash entered product adoption, next-generation small-pitch IGBT, high-voltage super-junction and Super IGBT processes entered mass production, a 40nm MCU entered mass production with a leading overseas customer, and the 40nm ultra-low-power process entered mass production. For H2 2026 the company expects the industry's strong structural momentum to continue.
quarterly_data.figure: power management sales +nearly 40%, embedded NVM +over 40%, standalone NVM +nearly 80% YoY in H1 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Hua Hong Semiconductor HKEX announcement: Interim Results Announcement for the Six Months Ended 30 (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out at June 30, 2026 (interim results): all equipment for the planned 83k wafers per month at the Wuxi Phase II project (Fab 9) was moved in by end-June 2026, with installation and qualification under way and planned capacity expected by the end of Q3; contracted but unprovided commitments for property, plant and equipment rose to US$3,248,394 thousand from US$1,238,613 thousand at end-2025; H1 property, plant and equipment acquired at a cost of US$833,563,000; cash and bank balances about US$4,532.2 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Fab 9 planned capacity 83k wafers/month; PP&E commitments US$3,248,394 thousand (US$1,238,613 thousand at end-2025)
